operation.description: Compute the exact rank of a bounded integer matrix over the prime field GF(p). The prime is supplied explicitly so that characteristic-dependent rank is always unambiguous.

examples.description: Compute the rank of [[1,0,1],[0,1,1],[1,1,0]] over GF(2); the entries must be canonical residues in [0, prime).
examples.name: rank_gf2

PrimeFieldMatrix.description: An immutable matrix with an exact prime and explicit empty shape.
PrimeFieldMatrix.title: PrimeFieldMatrix

input_schema.description: A bounded integer matrix over an explicit prime field GF(p), as the canonical `PrimeFieldMatrix` value: `prime` must be a prime integer in [2, 2147483647], `entries` must have at most 256 rows, each row 1..256 columns, all rows the same length matching the declared `columns`, and every entry a canonical residue in [0, prime). Zero rows are permitted and carry the explicit `columns` axis.
input_schema.title: PrimeFieldMatrixRequest

PrimeFieldMatrix.description: An immutable matrix with an exact prime and explicit empty shape.
PrimeFieldMatrix.title: PrimeFieldMatrix

PrimeFieldMatrixRequest.description: A bounded integer matrix over an explicit prime field GF(p), as the canonical `PrimeFieldMatrix` value: `prime` must be a prime integer in [2, 2147483647], `entries` must have at most 256 rows, each row 1..256 columns, all rows the same length matching the declared `columns`, and every entry a canonical residue in [0, prime). Zero rows are permitted and carry the explicit `columns` axis.
PrimeFieldMatrixRequest.title: PrimeFieldMatrixRequest

output_schema.description: Rank of a matrix over GF(p), retaining its source matrix.
output_schema.title: PrimeFieldMatrixRankResult
